name: Air New Zealand Limited
summary: Air New Zealand Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides air passenger and cargo transportation on scheduled airlines services in New Zealand, Australia, the Pacific Islands, Asia, the United Kingdom, Europe, and the Americas. The company offers engineering and maintenance services, including aircraft and component maintenance, repair, and overhaul services; aviation labour, and aircraft leasing and financing services; and captive insurance, aviation, and aircraft leasing and financing services.
